cc:Work.dc:title: oseen convergence
cc:Work.dc:description: oseen; all 5 measured levels; fixed final-four diagnostic window. Stabilized P3/P3 Oseen locals; vector P1 trace; smooth data, viscosity one. Smooth polynomial Oseen family; constant prescribed transport velocity; exact stored H; physical pressure gauge and original residual stabilization unchanged. Separate analytical velocity/pressure L2 errors and the stated V × Q product norm. Record examples/results/oseen/smooth-nu1-l1-uniform.json; SHA256 f0f286f8c5b1a199fc525cff2dc6c665bc7f51b91403a5d1707577cada43ad15. Araya, Cárcamo, Poza and Valentin (2021), section 5.1: mixed V × Q estimate of order ell+1; velocity L2 order three is observed separately.
